CholeskyQR2 for n=2048 (B=8, shape5) explored exhaustively and REJECTED. Measured the full CQR2 pipeline: int-Ozaki FP64 Gram 1.6ms + per-matrix FP64 chol 7.4ms + custom TRSM 1.8ms + orhr_col recon 7.8ms = ~19ms for 1 pass; but 1 pass FAILS the orth gate (diff guard: |QtQ-I| 0.025-0.044 > 0.0244 on 7/8 seeds) so a 2nd CholeskyQR pass is required -> ~27-29ms total, 3x SLOWER than the 8.69ms FP16 blocked panel, AND still could not clear the orth gate even with an exact-FP32 refinement Gram (0.0276 > 0.0244). Root cause: (1) the Cholesky is launch/parallelism-bound at B=8 (cuSOLVER potrf AND a custom tensor-core blocked chol both ~8ms; the trailing SYRK is only 37us but the diagonal potrf + panel TRSM dominate and don't batch at B=8), needed TWICE; (2) recon ~8ms (per-matrix cuBLAS trsm loop scales with B); (3) the blocked panel produces compact (H,tau) DIRECTLY with no Gram/chol/recon and at B=8 has enough CTAs to be reasonably filled, unlike B=2/n=4096 where CQR wins. Dispatch reverted to the panel; metric back at baseline 1926.79us. CQR2 code retained + documented as a dead-end.
